content: Clean the EGR valve and passages with carburetor cleaner and a brush. Inspect the valve for carbon buildup and sticking. Verify valve movement after cleaning. Clear DTCs and confirm EGR flow is within specification.

Replace the EGR valve with the correct OEM or equivalent part. Inspect mounting surface and gasket. Verify valve operation with a scan tool after replacement. Clear DTCs and confirm EGR flow is within specification.

Locate EVAP leaks with a smoke test. Replace cracked hoses, failed purge/vent valves, or leaking canisters. Inspect fuel cap seal and replace if damaged. Clear DTCs and confirm no leaks remain with a smoke test.
Replace the EVAP purge valve with the correct OEM or equivalent part. Inspect vacuum hoses for blockage. Verify valve operation with a scan tool or by listening for clicking when commanded.
Replace the EVAP vent valve with the correct OEM or equivalent part. Inspect vent hoses for blockage. Verify valve operation with a scan tool or by listening for clicking when commanded.
